stage: source-linked same-video pair ERM gate before any domain-generalization training
optimizer: AdamW, lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-4, gradient norm clip=1.0
model: copied raw CLIP/SlowFast sequence compatibility adapter with one cross-attention layer; 75,649 trainable parameters
natural_exposure: All strict inner-train rows once per epoch, identical order/seed policy in both arms.
pair_exposure: Each verified same-video source positive/reviewed full-query negative unit once per epoch in both arms; replay BCE is present in both arms to match pair-row exposure and update/compute count.
objective_difference: B0 receives replay BCE only. B1 adds 0.25 * mean softplus(0.2 - (score_positive - score_reviewed_negative)).
selection: Inner Seen-validation pooled AUROC, earliest tie. Novel-dev is not read during training.
pair_source_gate: Every unit must link source_qid to a human-temporally-annotated positive on the same video and have a user_attested_video_review negative. No absent label is inferred from missing annotation.
environment_audit: Construction type is attached to complete pair units. No meta-learning, IRM, or Group-DRO is authorized in this gate. A D1/D3 comparison will be considered only if B1 provides reproducible conditional evidence.
required_metrics: natural Seen and Novel pooled AUROC with video-cluster uncertainty
same-query cross-video PairAcc/AUROC with connected query-video component uncertainty
same-video source-linked PairAcc with video-cluster uncertainty
fresh pre-fusion raw-video swap followed by adapter forward with original labels retained only as dependence diagnostic
strict-inner canonical baseline AUROC and frozen Seen localization
parameter count, train/evaluation/shuffle cost, per-row predictions, coverage validation
interpretation_rule: A pooled gain without conditional support is not video-query compatibility evidence. A1-only conditional change is exploratory and does not pass the cross-fold gate.
